name: sawbuck-reins
description: Catch your coding agent gaming a check, and read how you steer. Not yet run end to end in Codex.

interface.longDescription: A deterministic, zero-LLM check re-proves every win from your source edits alone, so a green that came from editing the test, the grader, or the config is caught and sent back to earn it. Plus a cue inventory of how you steer, harvested from your Codex history. It uses your own tools, and the check never calls a model.
